data.target: Policy products and claims — CACI International
data.research_question: Which reports, model bills, testimony, executive-order proposals, litigation positions, and public claims from CACI International promote or implement transfer of public functions, assets, funding, or decision authority to private actors?
objectives: Enumerate policy outputs with publication dates, authors, sponsors, and exact proposals.
Classify the privatization mechanism: outsourcing, voucher, concession, deregulation, asset sale, private account, managed care, chartering, or contractor delegation.
Store attributed claims separately from adopted policy and measured outcomes.
hypotheses: Official public records will resolve at least part of the requested network.
The relationship graph will contain materially different edge types that must not be collapsed into a generic influence claim.
out_of_scope: control claims inferred only from funding, attendance, or membership
